omarchy-apple-music-mini.title: Apple Music Mini
omarchy-apple-music-mini.blurb: Miniplayer overlay for Omarchy Apple Music — latest upstream plus playback and UI tweaks.

omarchy-logomarchy.title: Logomarchy
omarchy-logomarchy.blurb: Omarchy logo wallpaper in every theme's colors. Size and colors from Style → Logomarchy.

omarchy-macromancy.title: Macromancy
omarchy-macromancy.blurb: Mac muscle memory on PC hardware — Command next to Space, plus select-all, undo, redo, hide, and quit.

omarchy-patina.title: Patina
omarchy-patina.blurb: Slight rounding, tight gaps, and a soft hue-matched glow. Toggle from Style → Patina.

omarchy-redlight.title: Redlight
omarchy-redlight.blurb: Bar toggle for a pure red Hyprland screen shader.

omarchy-soundstage.title: Soundstage
omarchy-soundstage.blurb: Media audio follows the screen the player is on.

omarchy-type.title: Type
omarchy-type.blurb: Omarchy font for Chromium apps: Apple Music, Grok Bot, YouTube.

omarchy-weather.title: Forecast
omarchy-weather.blurb: Temperature on the bar, UV by day, rain when it is coming.
